source.oracle_status: source-derived; original UWP runtime not validated
source.selection_reason: Three self-contained pages with deterministic navigation, deferred realization, responsive panes, and bundled images; no hardware, file picker, account, network, or external dialog is needed.

pages.description_prefix: Use deferral to prevent extraneous elements
pages.behavior: DeferredGrid starts unrealized. Realize Elements calls FindName("DeferredGrid"); four 100x100 colored rectangles appear. Repeated realization is idempotent. Navigating away and back creates a fresh unrealized page.

pages.description_prefix: Deferral can be used with VSM
mail: I'm going to need you to come in on Sunday too to cover for Bill.
Hey, can I get a link to the project you told me about?
Can you pick up some milk on your way home?
I heard you're heading to the Bahamas soon?  So jealous!
Your PTO request has been approved.  Please remember to log your time.
pages.behavior: Fresh narrow page has five bound mail rows only. At >=768 effective pixels ReadingPane realizes. At >=1200 AccountsList realizes with four bound accounts. Shrinking below768 hides ReadingPane and below1024 hides AccountsList. Expanding again restores them.
pages.caveats: The original hides already realized panes; it does not unload them. Dates are DateTime.Now-relative and are not compared literally. Send and Discard have no handlers and sending mail is not an expected feature.

pages.description_prefix: Deferral can be used in control templates
pages.behavior: Two TitledImage controls render the bundled rainier.jpg and valley.jpg at150x150. Only Rainier has a header. TitledImage uses Header/Source dependency properties and lazy HeaderPresenter realization with GetTemplateChild; preserve Themes/Generic.xaml.
